views.label: Hero
views.note: Drift and snap: six rings turn without stopping, and every second or so a few snap round as the view zooms; an 8 second loop.

views.label: A snap
views.note: Three rings caught mid-snap, smeared by a 180 degree shutter, while the view zooms in.

views.label: Zoomed in
views.note: The view at its closest, 1.7 times, the inner rings' tall ends as large as the type gets.

views.label: Detail, 2.5×
views.note: One ring tapering from tall capitals to small ones, its neighbour one gap away.

views.label: Detail, 3.5×
views.note: The inner ring, its line of small capitals running inside its large ones.

views.label: Detail, moving
views.note: The centre at 2.5 times through the loop, where the inner rings snap furthest and leave the longest trails.
